anna-people: Heads-up — Q2 performance review timeline is live in Confluence. Managers: please complete manager reviews by 2026-04-15 and ensure self-reviews are in by 2026-04-10. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/q2-reviews
hr-bot: Automated reminder: Review forms are open. Attach the `org-review-v2` Manager Review Form to each employee record. Deadlines enforced by system.
mike-eng: Quick Q — how detailed should peer feedback be? Are one-line notes okay or do you want examples?
sarah-manager: 3–5 bullets preferred with concrete examples (impact, metric, link to PR/incident). One-liners are fine as quick notes but try to add evidence for calibration.
jamal-people-ops: For visibility: we'll anonymize peer feedback for the calibration meeting. If you need non-anonymized context, DM me.
mike-eng: Can we get an exported CSV of direct reports + reviewers so I can bulk-attach files?
anna-people: Yep, sending the CSV to managers by EOD. Also shared calendar invites for calibration windows the week of Apr 20: slots 9:30–10:15, 13:00–13:45, 16:00–16:45 (45m each). Please claim a slot.
sarah-manager: I'll take Apr 21 13:00 and invite my skips.
olivia-ic: Do individual contributors need to submit self-reviews too? What's the self-review prompt?
anna-people: Yes — self-reviews due Apr 10. Prompt: accomplishments, blockers, growth areas, and top 3 goals for next cycle. Link to self-review form in Confluence. Encourage links to PRs, dashboards, and postmortems.
ken-englead: For eng teams, include key SLOs/metrics and any postmortems you authored — those are very helpful in calibration.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: forms due in 3 days. :rotating_light:
anna-people: Calibration committee will include a PM, an Eng Lead, and People Ops. Final calibration sync will be Apr 25 AM. Appeals window opens May 1 and runs for two weeks.
mike-eng: Thanks — I'll remind my team and block time. :thumbsup:
